in_arabic.name: قرشي
in_arabic.long_meaning: The exact meaning of the name Qureshi in Arabic is a matter of debate. Some sources suggest it means 'owner of the house' or 'descendant of Qusay'. Others propose it may mean 'noble' or 'distinguished'. The name is believed to be of Arabic origin, derived from the Quraysh tribe in Mecca.
